content.identity: 짧은 전선 변화와 지역 특성 조합을 중심으로 한 압축형 영토 전략 게임으로 재설계한다. 플레이어는 현재 경계 압력 읽고 영토 목표 선택, 단순 행동에서 성장 가능성이 실제 플레이에 열린다. 시그니처 세계 규칙은 MAIN/A/B/c/@ 역할로 기존 인과법칙과 상태 교환을 거친다. 영토전쟁의 핵심 재미는 최우선이며, 복잡한 용어나 반복은 깊이로 대체된다.

coreLoop: Read the current border pressure and choose one territory objective.
Commit units or resources to attack, reinforce or expand economy.
Resolve the territorial change and adapt the next plan to the new front line.

signatureSystems.name: Border Pressure Dynamics System
signatureSystems.purpose: Establishes causal relationships between player decisions and game state changes in a single-defense strategy game.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Deploy units or resources to attack, reinforce, or expand the economy based on current border pressure and territory objective selection criteria.

signatureSystems.name: Territory Expansion Dynamics System
signatureSystems.purpose: Plays a central role in the game's core mechanics, governing how players read border pressure and choose territory objectives, while also influencing resource deployment, economic expansion, and strategic front-line shifts.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Deploy units or resources to attack, reinforce, or expand the economy based on current border pressure and chosen territory objective, with outcomes that reflect both immediate consequences and long-term strategic implications.

signatureSystems.name: Territory Expansion and Adaptation System
signatureSystems.purpose: Adapt to border pressure by deploying units, allocating resources, and shifting the front line.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Deploy units based on territory objective, allocate resources strategically, shift front line according to new conditions.

signatureSystems.name: Territory Expansion and Adaptation Depth System
signatureSystems.purpose: Adapt the next plan to the new front line while maintaining territorial expansion depth
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Choose a territory objective that reflects both current border pressure and long-term strategic goals, with adaptive resource allocation and unit deployment based on evolving battlefield conditions and player mastery of gameplay mechanics.

signatureSystems.name: Territory Expansion and Adaptation Depth System
signatureSystems.purpose: Resolve territorial change and adapt to new front line through depth of expansion and adaptation
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Choose expansion strategy that balances immediate gain with long-term stability and flexibility
